title: docs(skills): objectstack-automation teaches the read-only `record_link` screen field, with an eval prompt
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8W2xMZ3uXnQ8MwyyurDKART)_
Fixes #26347
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` 的 `screen` 节点行(L91)教只读的屏幕字段 `type: 'record_link'`:它显示 `reference` 对象里 id 等于 `defaultValue` 求值结果的那条记录(按显示名,链接到记录页),不收输入;`reference` 与 `defaultValue` 必填,`required` / `options` / `placeholder` / `min` / `max` 拒收,恢复时在它名下带值拒收(`400 INVALID_SCREEN_INPUT`);附一个结果屏示例(`defaultValue: { dialect: 'cel', source: 'account.id' }` 读 `create_record` 的 `outputVariable`),并点明两种会被拒或原样显示的替代写法。eval 文件加第 9 题(卡上原题)。棘轮脚本两行上限按实测调整,裁决原文写在行旁;「Filter operands」小节删去一句重复 item 1 的话。
- **为什么改**:#26355 已把 `record_link` 落进 `@objectstack/spec`,技能没教。AI 作者写「创建完成后显示新记录链接」的结果屏时,会去写 completed `end` 的 `message`(被 spec 拒收)或在屏幕 `description` 里写 markdown 链接(runner 原样显示成文字)。
- **风险与回滚**:只改已发布技能包的文字、一个 eval 夹具和棘轮脚本的两行上限,不改运行时;回滚即 revert 本 PR(上限行随之回落)。
- **先看**:① `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` L91 `screen` 行的新增子句;② `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 两行上限及注释;③ `evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json` 第 9 题。
- **两分钟验证**:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` → 看到 `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md is 6164 tokens (ceiling 6164; headroom 0)` 与 `flows-triggers-approvals.json is 2141 tokens (ceiling 2141; headroom 0)`,末行 `authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings`。
- **需要你做的**:Tier H(`skills/**`),请 approve 或直接 Merge when ready。

## What changes

Card #26347's 「What is owed」 section, and nothing wider:

1. **`SKILL.md` L91, the `screen` node row** (the one home — the row already enumerates `config.fields[]` and teaches the `file` member, so an author writing a screen flow's result screen reads it): `'record_link'` (never `'record'`, an object field type) takes no input — it shows the `reference` record whose id `defaultValue` evaluates to, by display name, as a link to its record page; the one example `{ name: 'account_link', type: 'record_link', reference: 'crm_account', defaultValue: { dialect: 'cel', source: 'account.id' } }` over a `create_record` `outputVariable: 'account'`; both keys required; `required` / `options` / `placeholder` / `min` / `max` refused; a resume value under its name refused (`400 INVALID_SCREEN_INPUT`); a completed `end` `message` is refused and a markdown link in a screen `description` renders literally. Every clause was read from the merged code, not the card: `packages/spec/src/automation/builtin-node-config.zod.ts` (`SCREEN_FIELD_RECORD_LINK_TYPE`, `…_REFERENCE_REQUIRED`, `…_DEFAULT_VALUE_REQUIRED`, `SCREEN_FIELD_RECORD_LINK_REFUSED_KEYS`, the `superRefine` at the field, and `EndConfigSchema`'s refusal of `message` on a completed end), `screen-field-record-link.test.ts`, `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/screen-record-link-resume.test.ts` (the `account.id` spelling over `outputVariable: 'account'`, `INVALID_SCREEN_INPUT`), `screen-input-contract.ts`, the error-code ledger (400), and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/FlowRunner.tsx` (the `description` is a plain text child of the dialog description).
2. **`evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json`**: entry 9, the card's prompt verbatim; the ideal answer names the `screen` flow, two `create_record` nodes with `outputVariable`, the last `screen` of two `type: 'record_link'` fields with `reference` and `defaultValue: { dialect: 'cel', source: 'account.id' }` / `'contact.id'`, no `required` / `placeholder` / `options`, no completed-`end` `message`, no markdown link in the `description`; assertions as the card gives them. The expected output is written so that it never spells either `must_not_contain` string (it says "never the object field type" instead of the negated spelling).
3. **`SKILL.md` L209–210, Filter operands** — the one genuine duplicate cut: the bullet restated Valid-but-silently-wrong item 1's refusal detail (`expression-invalid`, "with its envelope"); the surviving home is item 1 at L233–235, which names the gate, the error id and the CEL spelling the refusal carries. −41 bytes.
4. **`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`**, the two objectstack-automation rows only, under the maintainer's ruling on the seat's decision card 「skills 修复卡的教学和 eval 都撞 token 天花板,怎么付?」, tap **A** (2026-10-27 01:21Z), verbatim and untranslated: 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」. Step one, duplicates cut first: the one above in `SKILL.md`; the eval file's eight fixtures share no sentence (0 bytes to cut). Step two, each row follows its measurement (`ceil(utf8 bytes / 4)`, `SKILL.md` minus its 20-byte stamp line): `SKILL.md` priced bytes 24014 → 24654 (+681 added, −41 cut, +640 net), 6004 → **6164** (headroom was 2 bytes, 0 tokens; +160); `evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json` 7289 → 8561 bytes (+1272), 1823 → **2141** (headroom was 3 bytes, 0 tokens; +318). Both pinned AT the measurement, each comment quoting the tap. Rows measured against `origin/main` `75afeffd` (#26420 landed), the branch's base; no other package's row is touched.

`references/_index.md` is generator-owned (`gen:skill-refs`) and unchanged (no schema moved). `references/examples-flows.md` is untouched (the row held the teaching). `SKILL.md` line 1 is untouched (#25640 owns the stamp). #26362 (the approval-lock read) is the next card on this package and is not taught here.

**Two readings** (lines, and tokens as the ratchet counts them):

| File | Lines before → after | Tokens before → after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `SKILL.md` | 441 → 441 (0) | 6004 → 6164 (+160) |
| `evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json` (not .md, reported for the raise) | 85 → 95 (+10) | 1823 → 2141 (+318) |
| **Whole package** (`SKILL.md` + `references/**/*.md`, 4 files; the package has no `rules/`) | **1001 → 1001 (0)** | **13931 → 14091 (+160)** |

Removed: the Filter operands restatement only.

`skip-changeset`: the published skills packages carry no `package.json`; nothing is released from any package.

## Why

The key landed in `@objectstack/spec` with PR #26355 (`4548ba34e6`) and the skill did not teach it, so an AI author asked for a result screen reached for a completed `end` `message` (refused at parse) or a markdown link in the screen `description` (shown as literal text). `Metadata-protocol: none`: the protocol already carries the key; the gap was the teaching.

## Tests

- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` — exit 0: both touched rows at headroom 0, `81 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings; 10 generator-owned file(s) measured, not ratcheted`.
- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs --self-test` — exit 0, `79 cases pass`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-docs`, `check:skill-refs`, `check:skill-examples` — see Verification. The new teaching is a table cell (inline code), so no `os:check` block was added; the example count stays as on `main`.
- Eval 9 is a fixture (the repo has no eval runner): a script checked every `must_contain` string occurs in its expected output and neither `must_not_contain` string occurs in the prompt or expected output.

## Acceptance notes

- The dispatch order's "inside the package's ceilings" cannot hold at headroom 0 on both touched files; the seat's claim widened the surface to the touched ratchet rows under the ruling above.
- `evals/README.md`, if it enumerates the eval topics, was not updated; not read, not filed: observation only.
- The PR body's first two lines are the harness-required attribution block (the os-dev exception); `Fixes #26347` follows immediately.

## Verification

Gate list derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on the final tree (base `75afeffd`, head `c9e57c28`), each run locally with the exit code captured before any pipe; `--ran` reconciliation below. No commit followed the gate runs, so every reading is of `c9e57c28`.

**Reconciliation** (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran ran.list --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`): exit 0 — `53 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 52 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`, 0 UNRUN.

The one NOT MEASURED is `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3: its prerequisite is a whole-repo build; this diff touches no package source, and CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs it — a declared narrowing). The closures for `check:skill-examples` and `check:doc-formula-expressions` (`@objectstack/client...`, `@objectstack/client-react...`, `@objectstack/lint...`, `@objectstack/formula...`) were built under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (slot `issue-26347`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`, 276 s held, 0 s waited); `check:dts-closure` and `check:lean-entry-closure` ran after that build (`38 built package(s) swept - 160/160 declared declaration file(s) present`). `node scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs` ran in the serial cheap runner, never beside `check:skill-examples`. `check:pm-dispatch-gates` ran detached on the final head: fast tier, `1901 cases pass`, exit 0. Two runs are outside the derivation and recorded anyway: `check:skill-refs` and `check:skill-examples`, the card's acceptance gates (the eval file and the row are the only skill edits; the example count stays at 264).
